regimes.reference: Operator declaration dated 2026-09-03, corrected 2026-09-10 against the retained primary text (docs/primary_sources/README.md). HEnEx Decision 10 'Timeline Procedures for the Day-Ahead and Intra-Day Market' of 20 October 2020 (ref. 2205/20.10.2020), in force at the 1 November 2020 launch of the Greek Day-Ahead Market: 'The Day-Ahead Market Gate Closure Time' at 12:00 (CET) / 13:00 (EET) on D-1. The same closure is stated by Decision 10 of 20 September 2021 (ref. 1371/20.09.2021) and of 31 March 2026 (ref. 700/31.03.2026). Greece's SDAC coupling from delivery day 2020-12-16 (NEMO Committee notice of 15 December 2020; RAE Decision 1574/2020) and the 15-minute market time unit from delivery day 2025-10-01 (SDAC notices of 12 September and 7 October 2025) changed neither the closure time nor its clock, so one regime is declared. The superseded 2026-09-03 declaration placed the closure before 2020-12-16 at 12:00 Europe/Athens; no admitted feature exists before 2021-02-27, so the correction changes no accepted observation. The repository tooling cannot verify this rule; the cited text is retained with the acceptance evidence.
